prompt:
Fix snippets/subscription-cadence-2.liquid. It shows a subscription delivery cadence with an optional note. Right now it always prints every wrapper element, even when there is no text to put inside it. Inputs (both are top-level variables passed to the snippet; nothing is under section.settings): - cadence_label: string or null. Example: "Every 2 weeks". - cadence_note: string or null. Example: "Skip or cancel anytime". Rules: 1. Strip leading and trailing whitespace from both values. Treat null the same as an empty string. 2. If the stripped cadence_label is empty, output nothing at all (an empty string), whatever the note contains. 3. Otherwise output exactly:
LABEL
4. If the stripped cadence_note is not empty, insert NOTE inside the div, immediately after the closing . If the stripped note is empty, do not output the small element at all. 5. HTML-escape LABEL and NOTE with the escape filter, after stripping them. 6. Do not output any whitespace or newlines before, between or after the elements. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/subscription-cadence-2.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
